verify.subject: Typle: Confirm your email address
verify.body:
Thank you for signing up for Typle.

Open the link below to confirm your email address (valid for 24 hours).

{link}

If you did not expect this email, you can safely delete it.

reset.subject: Typle: Reset your password
reset.body:
We received a request to reset your password.

Open the link below to set a new password (valid for 30 minutes, usable once).

{link}

If you did not request this, you can safely delete this email. Your password has not changed.
